div.div: Boxes are TESPy nodes (power_plant.nodes); arrows are power_plant.edges. Single fluid loop (CO2, common.fluid_name) throughout -- district_heating_hx, then injection_cooler densifies the CO2, then circulation_control (surface pressure source; no downhole pump).
